Visibly firm skin Appearance of reenergized skin Applied after the NEURAÉ Serum, the Energizing Cream helps restore tone to tired skin. Your facial expression looks revitalized and signs of fatigue look less apparent. Day after day, the Cream visibly firms your skin, providing a feeling of energy. Tolerance dermatologically tested For all skin types amp; sensitive skin 96% of naturalorigin ingredients How to Use: Day and Night Cream Step 1: Take a small amount of cream then spread the product over the backs of your fingers. With the backs of your fingers folded, apply the product to your face and neck, using light, energetic tapping motions. Step 2: Still using your fingertips, exert a sliding pressure from the center of the forehead towards the temples. Repeat this movement several times. Step 3: With the backs of your knuckles facing upwards, do the same, gliding under your cheekbones as if to highlight them. Step 4: Using your bent index fingers, smooth from your chin towards your ears. Step 5: Finally, apply pressure with your thumbs from behind your ears to the back of your neck. Your index finger naturally forms a pinch, amplifying the effect of the gesture. Key Ingredients: Unique ingredients that go beyond the surface to provide transformative solutions to rejuvenate dull, tired or stressed skin, visibly rebalancing facial features. Our cream is formulated with 96% ingredients of natural origin. Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. Red Indigo: The stimulating Red Indigo extract encourages the cutaneous level of positive messengers and limits the level of negative ones to reduce signs of fatigue on the skin. Jania rubens: The Seaweed extract has been selected for its richness in plantbased taurine, which has a powerful energizing action for toned skin. Vitamin C: The Vitamin C* is a cofactor in the synthesis of stimulating cutaneous messengers to energize the skin.
